\subsection{Primary Endpoint: Dual Hit-Rate}

The primary endpoint is the dual hit-rate difference
$\Delta\mathrm{hr}_{\mathrm{both}} = \mathrm{hr}_{\mathrm{both}}(\texttt{double})
- \mathrm{hr}_{\mathrm{both}}(\texttt{single\_x})$
on each of the five pre-registered core pairs.
A contrast is declared significant only if all three conditions hold:
BH-adjusted $p < 0.05$, $|\text{Cliff's } \delta| \geq 0.33$, and the
bootstrap 95\% CI excludes
zero~\citep{cameron2008bootstrap, cliff1993dominance, benjamini1995fdr}.

\subsection{No-Degradation Guard}

For every core pair, per-target hit-rates $\mathrm{hr}_a(\texttt{double})$
and $\mathrm{hr}_b(\texttt{double})$ are compared against the corresponding
single-mode baseline.  A pair is flagged if Cliff's $\delta < -0.47$
(large negative effect).

\subsection{Secondary Endpoints}

\paragraph{Score balance.}
Median $|a_A - a_B|$ per mode; lower values indicate more balanced
dual-target affinity.

\paragraph{Enrichment@K.}
For $K \in \{10, 50, 100, 500\}$, enrichment factor of dual hits
in the top-$K$ molecules ranked by $\max(a_A, a_B)$ ascending.

\paragraph{Pareto hypervolume.}
Hypervolume dominated by the non-dominated set in $(a_A, a_B)$ space,
with reference point $r = (2.0, 2.0)$.

\subsection{Exploratory Endpoints}

\paragraph{Reward weight-space spectrum.}
Comparison of all six modes (including exploratory \texttt{linear\_equal},
\texttt{biased\_a}, \texttt{selective\_a}) on dual hit-rate and per-target
hit-rates, reported descriptively.

\paragraph{Docking--Boltz-2 concordance.}
Per-target Spearman $\rho(d_X, a_X)$ as a sanity check for surrogate agreement.

\paragraph{Chemical diversity.}
Internal diversity (Tanimoto), scaffold diversity, and uniqueness
across modes.

\subsection{Sensitivity Analyses}

\paragraph{Threshold sensitivity.}
Primary analysis repeated at $T \in \{-1.0, 0.0, +1.0\}$
(100\,nM, 1\,$\mu$M, 10\,$\mu$M).

\paragraph{Equal docking calls.}
Single modes with doubled RL epochs (400) to equalize
training-time docking budget.

\paragraph{Alternative scalarizations.}
Offline re-computation of reward under geometric mean, harmonic mean,
weighted sum, weighted product, and Tchebycheff decomposition.
